title: Vignette 2026-11-04: the clerk is a proof of concept; many people will need a generic tool

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: The multi repo mcp is probably going to generate this issue for many people. This work can belong in the clerk for now, but that is probably a POC. But the clerk is an internal workflow experiment for now. Eventually we need to be able to offer some kind of generic tool for this process
